note.text: 63-year-old female presenting with cough and breathlessness for 3 years. Character: wheezing, worse at night; radiation: n/a; aggravated by dust and cold air; relieved by inhaler. Severity 3/10. Associated: chest tightness. PMH: Hypertension for 15 years; Asthma since childhood; Coronary artery disease, stent 8 years ago. Drugs: Amlodipine 5 mg; Salbutamol inhaler 100 mcg; Aspirin 75 mg; Atorvastatin 20 mg. Allergy: no known allergies. Family: diabetes. Personal: non-smoker, no alcohol. Triage: ROUTINE.
